bugs.name: Customer Types list retains stale Default marker after restoring original default
bugs.summary: After restoring the original Default type, the Customer Types list repeatedly shows Default pills on both it and the test type until the list is refreshed.
bugs.expected: After setting the original Default customer type as default again, only its row should show the Default marker.
bugs.actual: After returning to the list, both the original Default row and the test type row showed a Default pill. The duplicate markers remained visible after five seconds and recurred on a second set-and-restore cycle. Refreshing the list cleared the test type's marker, indicating the in-app list was stale.
reproSteps: Create and submit a fresh uniquely named customer type, for example “Momentic Default Restore Repro 202609260246-2a0008.”
On the new type's detail page, open More actions and choose Set as default.
Return to the customer types list, open the existing Default type, then open More actions and choose Set as default. Wait for the success notification.
Return to /customer-types/?asc=true&sort=name. Both the Default row and the test type row show a Default pill; the duplicate remains visible after five seconds.

Repeat setting the test type as default and restoring the original Default. The list again shows both Default pills. Refreshing the list removes the test type's marker; then delete the non-default test fixture.

bugs.name: Customer type private metadata is not present when the metadata editor is reopened after saving
bugs.summary: Saving Private Metadata on a newly created customer type closes the editor, but reopening it shows Empty and loses the entered key/value; the loss remains after a page refresh.
bugs.expected: After using Save in the Customer Type Metadata editor, the entered private metadata field and value should remain available when the editor is reopened. The editor presents Add Field controls for Field and Value and a Save action.
bugs.actual: The editor closed with a Metadata updated toast, but Private Metadata was Empty when reopened and remained Empty after a page refresh.
reproSteps: Sign in to the local Saleor fixture as admin@example.com and create a disposable Customer Type.
Open Edit customer type metadata, expand Private Metadata, and add a unique key and value.
Save the metadata editor and confirm the Metadata updated toast.
Reopen the editor and expand Private Metadata; it says Empty.
Refresh the customer type page and reopen the editor; Private Metadata still says Empty.
